Code: 
perl -0pi -e 's/(PVE::Tools::run_command\(\s*\[\x27umount\x27,\s*\$path\],\s*timeout\s*=>\s*)20/$1 65/' \
/usr/share/pve-manager/migrations/pve-cephx-rotate-service-keys

After that the storage keys and admin key was successful:

Code: 
root@pve01:/etc/pve/priv/ceph#...

item.content:encoded:
Recent security findings and fixes in Ceph make it necessary to upgrade ceph and migrate authentication keys from the aes to the aes256k cipher. This is to address weaknesses in the old Cephx authentication method, especially if your Ceph service networks are not isolated.
